cands.name: Rick Roth
cands.bio: Republican nominee. Former Florida House member (District 85, then 94) 2016-2024. Born in West Palm Beach in 1952; Emory University. The Roth family runs Roth Farms in Belle Glade.
cands.local_ties: Born in West Palm Beach; family farm company Roth Farms is in Belle Glade, Palm Beach County. The link between Rick Roth and the farm is not stated on the farm's site.

record.text: Florida House 2016-2024; won 2016 primary with about 62% and general with 57.7%.

cands.gaps: No donor reporting, endorsements, or controversies found. Occupation not confirmed by a source that names him. Owner-source search not run (web search quota exhausted).

votes.what: Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).

cands.name: David Silvers
cands.bio: Democratic nominee. Former Florida House member (Districts 87 and 89) 2016-2024. Born in Miami Beach in 1979; University of Florida and University of Miami.
cands.local_ties: Born in Miami Beach; represented Palm Beach County districts in the House.

record.text: Florida House 2016 to Nov 2024; unopposed in the 2016 general election.
